data.body:
RP-01 candidate-attempt observability approved after refinement. Maintainer response: “yes”. Final decision: Pydantic `RunUsage.requests` remains the sole request-budget and core usage request count. Fallback and native-to-prompted candidate attempts do not enter `_usage`, pricing, `UsageLimits`, or durable usage JSONL. When operational visibility is required, emit candidate-identified trace or journal events through public Pydantic model instrumentation, including ordering, model identity, and returned/raised outcome; never fabricate token usage for a failed attempt without provider-reported usage. Fallback fan-out remains bounded by the explicit candidate chain and predicate, and provider transport retries remain disabled or separately bounded.

All RP-01 Phase-4 decisions are now approved: one operation-wide request budget with the raise-the-reviewed-limit caveat; complete failed response only on proven fit otherwise whole omission; bounded output-size retry with concise guidance; terminal refusal/filter; aggregate successful-run usage; exact cause-chain restoration; and trace-not-usage candidate observability. RP-01 is ready for the later janitor ticketization phase.
